title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: The fourth per file cache still emptied itself completely, and three of the tests guarding the change could not tell the two behaviours apart.

highlights.title: All four caches, one rule
highlights.description: The state provenance cache still emptied itself once full, which makes every open editor recompute at once. It was the one not migrated, in the very release that added the shared helper to stop them drifting apart.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Three of the new cache tests asserted the cache stays under its ceiling, which is true of both behaviours, so reverting the change left them green. They now assert it stays full, which only one behaviour produces.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: A file you keep coming back to is served from cache on 196 of 199 returns while browsing 200 other files, because a miss puts it back at the end of the queue.
